lineage.description: Built-up area boundaries for Elazig province were derived from direct observational GIS data sourced from Başarsoft. The dataset contains spatial polygons representing built-up areas with associated attributes including building type codes, administrative divisions (province, district, village, neighborhood), and population counts, providing a baseline exposure inventory for the region.
